image_description: A vintage-style minibus parked on a paved street with buildings in the background. The vehicle has a two-tone color scheme (beige/cream lower body, dark brown/black upper front) with red accents and text on the side. It features a boxy shape, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. There is a tripod stand in the foreground left.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits a distinct boxy silhouette typical of minibuses. Its length is visibly shorter than a standard city bus, and the roof height suggests adequate interior headroom.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is clearly visible at the front. A continuous row of rectangular side windows runs along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width. A door frame is visible behind the front wheel arch, indicating a front/mid-body entrance configuration.
The vertical seam and handle mechanism near the front wheel indicate a sliding or folding door structure, consistent with minibus designs.
The short hood/nose section ahead of the windshield and driver's seat indicates a conventional front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is occluded by the viewing angle; only the side and front-three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle displays a specific livery (beige/brown/red) with text/markings on the side, fitting the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle size, resembling standard commercial van/truck wheels with visible rims.
Based on the window count and overall dimensions, the capacity aligns with the 4-10 passenger range typical for this class.

artifact_observations.location: Side of the bus body and front destination sign
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side panels and the digital display above the windshield appears distorted and illegible. Characters are malformed or fused, a common artifact in AI-generated vehicles where text rendering fails.

The front grille and bumper geometry is inconsistent. The horizontal lines of the grille warp and merge into the bumper without clear separation. The headlight assembly on the right side seems to float or lack proper housing integration.
The ellipses of the wheels do not perfectly align with the perspective of the bus body. The front wheel appears slightly detached from the ground plane, and the rim geometry is somewhat irregular.
The reflections in the side windows are muddy and do not clearly reflect the surrounding environment (buildings/sky) in a physically accurate way, appearing more like painted smudges.
